sensing-gatemix: sensing-epigate's trial with the mismatch rate and mix measured by sensing-matchreal, 8 seeds per cell.
Rig: 300 features, 12 views, 0.5 px noise, pose error 0.5 deg / 0.02 radii, gate 2 px Sampson, vote 0.5. Synthetic geometry; only the mismatch rate and mix are measured.
Each cell: label = rate/along/near/far shares. measured = SIFT on the Middlebury pair; uniform = same rate, all random pixels (the earlier assumption); alongonly = same rate, all along-epipolar.
